title: National Association of the Deaf (NAD)
description: The NAD is the leading civil rights organization for deaf and hard of hearing people in the United States, advocating for equal access in education, employment, healthcare, and technology.

title: American Society for Deaf Children (ASDC)
description: The ASDC is a family-led organization that supports parents and families of deaf and hard of hearing children, promoting ASL and bilingual (ASL/English) approaches so families can communicate fully with their deaf children.
